subject: Next steps & procurement blockers — vendor packet / PO vs card decision
messages:
From: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.ai>
To: Lena Morris <lena@acmehealth.com>, Tom Reyes <tom.reyes@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-01T14:12:00-07:00
Subject: Post-call recap + what we need from procurement to unblock

Hi Lena / Tom — thanks again for the time today. Quick recap from our end and clear asks so procurement can move forward: 

- What we heard: you want a short pilot (3 months) to evaluate latency/cost on your most common inference workload; you prefer no data egress, and need contract language around retention and KMS.
- Commercial path options we discussed: 1) PO + net30 with a short SOW (recommended for enterprise billing), 2) Credit card to start pilot immediately, 3) Marketplace purchase to avoid vendor paperwork but may delay if procurement insists on vendor packet.

As next steps from Acme procurement: can you confirm which path (PO vs card vs marketplace) you want to pursue for the pilot? If PO, procurement will need our vendor packet and a completed SOC2 checklist. I attached the updated proposal and vendor packet PDF to speed things up.

Attachments: redwood-proposal-v2.pdf, redwood-vendor-packet.zip

If helpful, we can sign an NDA or start a tightly-scoped pilot order on card while vendor packet is processed. Please let me know best contact and timeline (example: "Finance/Procurement will review by 11/8").

Thanks — Priyom

Priyom Das
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
pri...@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0123

From: Lena Morris <lena@acmehealth.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.ai>
Cc: Procurement Ops <procurement@acmehealth.com>, Tom Reyes <tom.reyes@acmehealth.com>
Date: 2026-11-02T09:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + what we need from procurement to unblock

Thanks, Priyom — good write-up. Quick answers: 

- Our default is to run through PO / vendor onboarding for any vendor that will touch patient-adjacent data; pilot could be an exception but needs a formal exception ticket.
- Procurement has requested: vendor packet, SOC2 attestation, and a sample SOW or quote.
- Timeline: procurement team said they can start review this week but we have a scheduled vendor review on 11/10. If we can get the vendor packet + SOC2 today/tonight they will try to accelerate.

I'm copying procurement so they have context.

—Lena
Lena Morris
Head of Data Platform | Acme Health
lena@acmehealth.com

From: Procurement Ops <procurement@acmehealth.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.ai>, Lena Morris <lena@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Tom Reyes <tom.reyes@acmehealth.com>
Date: 2026-11-02T09:47:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + what we need from procurement to unblock

Hi all — procurement here. Two quick asks to put Redwood into our vendor queue: 

1) Completed vendor packet (we prefer the spreadsheet with the fields populated rather than a generic zip).
2) SOC2 report or an external attestation URL + any certs, and a primary invoice contact.

If you can provide both, we can create a PO and aim for net30. If Redwood can only provide a credit-card option for a pilot, we will still evaluate but it will require finance sign-off.

Thanks,
Procurement Ops
procurement@acmehealth.com

From: Tom Reyes <tom.reyes@acmehealth.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.ai>
Cc: Lena Morris <lena@acmehealth.com>, Procurement Ops <procurement@acmehealth.com>
Date: 2026-11-02T11:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + what we need from procurement to unblock

Priyom — I also wanted to flag that our platform team is interested in the cloud marketplace route (Azure Marketplace) because it would let us start immediately without vendor onboarding. That said, procurement still wants the vendor packet on file. Can Redwood publish a marketplace listing or share marketplace purchase instructions?

If marketplace is available, procurement may accept a shorter internal review. Either way, we need the packet and SOC2 link.

Tom
Tom Reyes
Director, Platform Engineering | Acme Health
tom.reyes@acmehealth.com

From: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.ai>
To: Lena Morris <lena@acmehealth.com>, Tom Reyes <tom.reyes@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-03T09:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + what we need from procurement to unblock

Lena / Tom — following up with the items procurement requested and proposed paths so you have language for your review meeting next week: 

1) Vendor packet: attached as a filled spreadsheet and a zip. If procurement prefers individual fields, please take redwood-vendor-packet.zip and let me know which items are missing.
2) SOC2: our attestation URL is https://redwood.ai/security/soc2 (included above), and I attached a redacted SOC2 summary for procurement.
3) Marketplace: we can publish on Azure Marketplace but there is a ~2 week lead time for listing approval. If you want to go that route for immediate purchase, we can try to prioritize but it is not instantaneous.
4) Short-term pilot alternative: we will accept a credit card payment for a scoped 3-month pilot (invoice + refund/credit if PO is later executed) — this has worked for other customers to avoid gating product evaluation. If Acme wants this, confirm the finance contact and I will route the billing request.

Attachments: redwood-vendor-packet.zip, redwood-proposal-v2.pdf, redwood-soc2-summary.pdf

Marissa / Vivek — looping you both to note the request for a filled vendor packet and the potential ask to accept card to unblock. Marissa: can you confirm whether we can offer a temporary credit-card pilot discount (we discussed 15% last quarter) and provide an invoicing contact? Vivek: please confirm SOC2 summary is ok to send redacted and whether legal wants a temp MSA or an NDA first.

If I don't hear back by EOD Wednesday (11/03), I'll send a short reminder to procurement.

Thanks — Priyom

[Attachment: redwood-vendor-packet.zip (spreadsheet + vendor docs)]
[Attachment: redwood-proposal-v2.pdf (PDF, 98KB)]
[Attachment: redwood-soc2-summary.pdf (PDF, 45KB)]
